description: This file defines the CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand class, a console command for creating database savepoints within the OrangeHRM testing framework. It includes command configuration and execution logic that interacts with the DatabaseBackupService to create a savepoint with a specified name.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class that creates a database savepoint with a specified name, integrated into the OrangeHRM testing framework.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to create a database savepoint using DatabaseBackupService.
